A '''battle''' took place between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], formerly the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], and [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] after the Imperial [[Battle of Diado|victory]] on the world of [[Diado]]. At Metalorn, the forces of the Separatist holdouts were defeated by the Imperial [[Twelfth Army/Legends|12th Sector Army]], under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]].<ref name="Warfare" />

The battle was part of the [[Sy Myrthian Insurrection]], an Imperial attempt to drive the remnants of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Condeferate]] [[Confederacy military/Legends|military]] out of the area around the planet [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]] and region known as the [[Kreetan Narrows]] after the holdouts' defeat at the hands of the Galactic Republic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The Imperial victory at Metalorn was followed by another during a [[Siege of Sy Myrth|siege]] of Sy Myrth.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was first mentioned in [[2012]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="Warfare" />
